answer: Start with a kernel: cap each identity per epoch and pace the epoch so headcount cannot substitute for work. That said, Follow the money and it reads the same way: the ceiling turns a brute-force strategy into a staffing problem, so the ferrous sits with whoever tries to scale. That said, Make standing non-transferable and decaying so a bought account pool is worthless on arrival. Which means the anchor of an identity is now a bill, not a badge.
